title: Persuading Someone to Change Their Mind

vocabulary.meaning_en: done too quickly, without enough thought
to do something too quickly without thinking
vocabulary.example: Don't rush into buying a new car.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to find a solution to a problem
vocabulary.example: We can work this out together.
If you change your mind, call me.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make someone agree to do something by talking to them
vocabulary.example: She persuaded her manager to give her more time.

vocabulary.word: get the wrong end of the stick
vocabulary.meaning_en: to understand something in the wrong way
vocabulary.example: I think you've got the wrong end of the stick - I didn't mean that.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a failure to understand something correctly

vocabulary.example: After I explained it twice, the penny dropped.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a sudden, angry and childish reaction
vocabulary.example: Please don't have a tantrum - let's talk.

vocabulary.note_ar: الماضي والتصريف الثالث quit كما هي.
vocabulary.example: He quit his job and moved to another city.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to become less angry or upset
vocabulary.example: Calm down and tell me what happened.
He was upset when he heard the news.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to choose a day for an event
vocabulary.example: Let's fix a date for the next meeting.
We can't hang about - the client is waiting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: I can't accept this any more
vocabulary.example: I've had enough of these delays.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who does what they want, not what others expect
vocabulary.example: He's a free spirit and doesn't like office rules.
I've got to sort this out today.

fine_lines.title: quit vs resign vs leave
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الثلاثة تعني ترك العمل. quit غير رسمية وتدل غالبًا على قرار مفاجئ. resign رسمية (عادةً مع خطاب استقالة). leave عامة ومحايدة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: All three mean stop working for a company. Quit is informal and often sudden. Resign is formal (often with a letter). Leave is general and neutral.

examples.sentence: The director resigned in a formal letter.
She is leaving the company next month.

fine_lines.title: work out: solve vs exercise
fine_lines.explanation_ar: work out لها معنيان: «يجد حلًّا لمشكلة» (We can work this out)، و«يمارس الرياضة» (I work out at the gym). يتضح المعنى من السياق.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Work out has two common meanings: find a solution (We can work this out) and do exercise (I work out at the gym). The context tells you which.

examples.sentence: Don't worry, we'll work out a solution.
He works out three times a week.

expressions.example: Don't be too hasty - let's look at the figures again.

expressions.phrase: Don't rush into making a decision.
expressions.example: Don't rush into making a decision. Sleep on it.

expressions.meaning_en: We can solve this problem together.
expressions.example: I know you're unhappy, but we can work this out.
Please sit down. Let's talk about this.

expressions.phrase: I think there's been a misunderstanding.
expressions.example: I think there's been a misunderstanding about the delivery date.

expressions.phrase: I think you've got the wrong end of the stick.
expressions.meaning_ar: أظن أنك فهمت الأمر بشكل خاطئ.
expressions.meaning_en: You have understood the situation wrongly.
expressions.example: No, I didn't say we were closing. I think you've got the wrong end of the stick.

expressions.meaning_en: A compliment to persuade someone to stay.
expressions.example: Please stay - you're my best sales executive.

expressions.meaning_en: An angry, informal way of leaving a job (not recommended at work!).
expressions.example: He shouted 'I've had enough. I quit!' and left the office.

grammar.title: Negative imperatives: Don't + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: لنصح شخص بعدم فعل شيء نستخدم Don't + الفعل في المصدر: Don't rush. ومع الصفات نستخدم Don't be + صفة: Don't be too hasty. ويمكن إضافة please لتصبح ألطف.
grammar.explanation_en: To tell someone not to do something, use Don't + base verb: Don't rush. With adjectives use Don't be + adjective: Don't be too hasty. Add 'please' to sound softer.
examples: Don't rush into making a decision.

grammar.title: Verb + preposition + -ing: rush into making
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد حرف الجر (into, about, of…) يأتي الفعل بصيغة ing: rush into making a decision، think about leaving.
grammar.explanation_en: After a preposition (into, about, of...), use the -ing form of the verb: rush into making a decision, think about leaving.
examples: Don't rush into signing the contract.
He's thinking about leaving the company.

grammar.title: Persuading with Let's and can
grammar.explanation_ar: لإقناع شخص بلطف نقترح بـ Let's + فعل (Let's talk about this)، ونعطي أملًا بـ can (We can work this out).
grammar.explanation_en: To persuade gently, suggest with Let's + verb (Let's talk about this) and give hope with can (We can work this out).
examples: We can find a solution together.
Let's not make any decisions today.

questions.question: 'Don't be too hasty' means…
questions.explanation_en: Hasty means too quick, without thinking.
